verdict.rationale: Clerky documents online Delaware formation (C-corp and public benefit corporation), where a document set bundles the documents, signatures, and filings and Clerky handles formation work. A community user also confirms incorporating through it. However, the evidence never names bylaws or initial board approvals, so the end-to-end scope of the story is only implied. missing for 10: explicit evidence that bylaws and initial board consents/approvals are generated, independent hands-on corroboration of the full filing-to-board-approval flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can incorporate a Delaware startup end-to-end online, including the filing, bylaws, and initial board approvals
